summary: The registrant, Sadot Group Inc., filed an 8-K reporting entry into a settlement agreement with Helena Global Investment Opportunities I Ltd. The agreement resolves claims arising from an equity line of credit facility and a lawsuit. Terms include a $350,000 cash payment by July 17, 2026, dismissal of the lawsuit, and termination of all obligations under the prior agreements. The filing does not constitute an M&A transaction, activist campaign, or other special situation. It is a routine dispute resolution and contract termination. No deal terms such as price per share or premium are applicable.
